mille-isles.suspected_crs_mismatch: Source native = EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator). The served nested carries a ~1705m uniform offset (R=0.89) introduced during the original disaggregation/reprojection (a 3857->4326 parameter error; magnitude is far too large for a NAD83<->WGS84 datum shift ~1-2m and far too small for a wrong MTM zone). Fix = RE-CAPTURE authoritative bytes (filter co_mun=76030) + reproject 3857->4326 correctly; NEVER shift the served geometry (fabrication).
mille-isles.notes: Source is live, public, complete (66/66) and carries zone_code (field 'zone') — this is also a valid RE-ACQUERABLE-VECTOR endpoint; classified OFFSET-REPROJECT because the defect is a systematic offset over an already-correct source. R=0.89 (not perfectly rigid) means a residual may remain from source-digitization imprecision; verify at re-capture that the corrected reprojection closes the 1.7km.
